_comment: Mega Chippy, Acomb (York) — LumiWEB customer, LIVE. Branding modelled on the reference site (Poppies Fish & Chips): indigo + teal on a clean light palette, heavy display type over Montserrat body. Legal entity: AYAZ LARA LTD (14372361). Live at acombmegachippy.uk (sole domain); Stripe Connect acct set; card + cash (collection & delivery) enabled. Reminder for future deploys: use Cloudflare 'Create deployment' (builds latest main) — a 'Retry' rebuilds an OLD commit and can ship stale config (e.g. cash flags).

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name.
business._comment_todo: Domain migration COMPLETE (2026-07-28). acombmegachippy.uk is the only domain: canonical/schema/sitemap, the till Restaurant ID 318181, Resend sending (SPF/DKIM on this domain) and Cloudflare Email Routing orders@ -> shop inbox. megachippy.co.uk has been detached from the Pages project; keep the registration so nobody else takes a name tied to the shop, but nothing depends on it. Remaining SEO gaps: seo.sameAs is empty (needs the shop Facebook/Instagram URLs) and the site still needs submitting to Google Search Console.
business._comment_domain: acombmegachippy.uk is the ONLY domain (canonical tag, JSON-LD url, sitemap, OG) and is what the Google Business Profile points at — canonical MUST keep matching the GBP link or Google is told the real page lives elsewhere. Switched 2026-07-28 after verifying /api/config served and a test order completed on it. megachippy.co.uk was detached from the Pages project once email moved and the old till was retired. The old agency sites (acombmegachippy.com, acombmegachippyyork.co.uk) are NOT ours, cannot be redirected, and are outranked over time via the Business Profile.

_comment_seo: Search-engine extras used to build the landing page's JSON-LD Restaurant schema + social meta. Purely for search engines — doesn't change the page visually.

seo.description: Mega Chippy — proper fish and chips in Acomb, York. Freshly fried cod & haddock, chunky chips, chippy classics and kids' boxes. Order online for collection.
seo._comment_sameAs: Social profiles, emitted as schema.org sameAs. This is how Google ties the website, the social pages and the Google Business Profile together as ONE business entity, which is why it matters for local search. Found from public listings 2026-07-28 — if either link is not the shop's real page, correct it, because pointing at the wrong profile is worse than none.

_comment_theme: Palette + type taken from the customer's reference brand (Poppies Fish & Chips): CREAM background #FFF7E8 (never a cold white), indigo #3E46BA = primary (the pill buttons, headings, links), teal #54C2CC = secondary accent, and a warm heritage red #E23A2E for highlights (script wordmark / stars, echoing Poppies' red script logo). Type per the reference: headings = Rockwell Bold ('RockwellStdBold') → Rokkitt, its closest Google Fonts clone; UI caps (nav/buttons) = Heavitas → Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase; body = Montserrat; script accents = Pacifico (stand-in for the red brush-script logo). The shared order template puts light text on the primary colour, so primary stays dark enough for white text.

collection._comment_collectAddress: Shop asked to capture the customer's address on collection orders too. The order page adds a required address step for collection; /api/order enforces it; the printed ticket shows it.

delivery._comment: POSTCODE (outcode) pricing + a hard 4-mile ROAD cap. Fee is set per outcode in feeByOutcode (pence). On top of that, maxMiles 4 with roadFactor 1.3 geocodes the postcode (postcodes.io, free) and refuses delivery beyond 4 road miles even for a priced outcode — so the sprawly bits of an outcode (e.g. YO26 reaching 6–7 miles) become collection-only. allowedOutcodes is the deliverable list; feePence is a safe fallback if an allowed outcode is ever left unpriced. Owner-agreed prices: YO24 £2, YO26 £2.50, YO23 £2.50, YO30 £3.50, YO1 £3.50, YO10 £6, YO31 £6.
delivery.areaDescription: in the York area (within 4 miles of us)

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order service charge in pence (shown at checkout). serviceFeePlatformPence is the platform's (Lumin Labs') cut taken as the Stripe application_fee; the rest stays with the shop. £1.00 charge = 50p platform + 50p shop.
_comment_stripe: Live Stripe Connect account for Mega Chippy (AYAZ LARA LTD). Platform Stripe secrets + this shop's Connect webhook (whsec) are set in Cloudflare. NOTE: the connected account is created but the owner must finish Stripe onboarding (verify owners/address/phone, bank, ID, accept terms) before it is 'charges enabled' — until then live card payments are declined by Stripe even though the id is set here.

hours._comment: 24-hour format. Sat 11:30-20:50; Sun & Mon 15:00-20:50 (open 3pm); Tue-Fri 11:30-20:50. (8:50pm close = 20:50.) Monday history: owner-supplied 15:00, changed to 11:30 on 2026-07-20 (thought they opened for Monday daytime collection), then set back to 15:00 on 2026-07-27 — shop confirmed Sunday AND Monday both open at 3pm.

_comment_closures: One-off emergency closures. Each "YYYY-MM-DD" (shop-local) takes online ordering OFFLINE for that whole day and shows a popup. Self-expires once the date passes. Empty means no closure in effect.
_comment_closures_active: HOLIDAY CLOSURE ACTIVE — the shop is away Mon 17 to Thu 20 Aug 2026 and reopens Fri 21. Deliberately FOUR DATED entries rather than a "*" wildcard: dated entries expire by themselves, so Friday comes back on sale on its own and nobody has to remember to push a change that morning. A "*" would have stayed closed until someone removed it. Nothing to clean up afterwards — a past date is ignored.

_comment_promo: firstOrders = a signed-in customer gets `percent`% off the subtotal of their first `limit` orders (a welcome offer to reward sign-ups). Enforced server-side against the account's redemption count — guests/walk-ins never qualify, and a redemption is only spent when an order is actually placed (cash) or paid (card), so an abandoned card payment doesn't burn one. Takes precedence over autoOnlineDiscount (they don't stack). Set enabled:false to end it.
_comment_payments: Cash on collection AND delivery are ON so the shop can take online orders now (cash doesn't need Stripe). Card also works once the venue's Stripe Connect onboarding is charges-enabled. To make delivery prepaid-card-only, set cashOnDeliveryEnabled:false.
